lines.text: 核心区别：比较的不是“谁更高级"
lines.zh: 核心区别：比较的不是“谁更高级”
lines.en: Core distinction: the comparison is not “which is more advanced”

lines.text: 耦合方式、功率分工与鞘层行为决定工艺窗口
lines.zh: 耦合方式、功率分工与鞘层行为决定工艺窗口
lines.en: Coupling method, power allocation and sheath behavior determine the process window

lines.text: 线圈耦合一电子加热一电离/解离
lines.zh: 线圈耦合→电子加热→电离/解离
lines.en: Coil coupling → electron heating → ionization / dissociation
A. What should actually be compared

lines.text: 电极电场一鞘层/自偏压一离子入射
lines.zh: 电极电场→鞘层/自偏压→离子入射
lines.en: Electrode field → sheaths / self-bias → ion incidence
ICP: Source and Bias roles are easier to allocate,
But they are not completely decoupled.

lines.zh: CCP：结构直接，密度/鞘层/化学
lines.en: CCP: direct structure; density / sheath / chemistry

lines.text: 相同功率=相同离子能量
lines.zh: 相同功率=相同离子能量

lines.text: •选型 选设备通道数，关键：功率怎么配＋鞘层怎么控，。
lines.zh: 选型 ≠ 选设备通道数，关键：功率怎么配＋鞘层怎么控
lines.en: Selection ≠ choosing the number of equipment channels; the key is how power is allocated and sheaths are controlled
